notes.title: LIV Camera! (1.5.8)
notes.content: [p]- Added LIV Camera[/p][p]- Several smaller bug fixes related to player colors[/p][p]- Fixed bugs related to KOTH[/p][p]- Fixed bugs related to Player Reporting[/p][p]- General security & stability[/p]

>XP Gain & Global Leaderboards have been enabled for the KOTH gamemode
>Equipped cosmetics now save again
>(steam)Made tweaks to the network managers so horror monsters can now exist in lobbies marked as "modded"
>(hopefully) Fixed a bug that caused players to get muted/unmuted when players join/leave
>Fixed internal bugs related to player reporting

notes.title: Summer Flashback
